description: This file defines a templated Image class for image processing operations such as cropping, interpolation, downsampling, edge detection, and convolution, used within the TensorFlow Android test object tracking module.

classes.name: Image
classes.description: A templated class representing an image, providing methods for image manipulation such as cropping, extracting patches, interpolation, downsampling, and filtering operations.

classes.name: Size
classes.description: A structure likely representing image or viewport size (implied from usage).

classes.name: BoundingBox
classes.description: A structure representing an axis-aligned bounding box.

methods.name: bool ExtractPatchAtSubpixelFixed1616(const int fp_x,const int fp_y,const int patchwidth,const int patchheight,DstType * to_data) const
methods.description: Extracts a pixel patch from the image at subpixel accuracy using bilinear interpolation with fixed 16.16 point precision.

methods.name: Image<T> * Crop(const int left,const int top,const int right,const int bottom) const
methods.description: Creates a cropped sub-image defined by the rectangle specified.

methods.description: Performs bilinear interpolation to get pixel value at floating point coordinates.

methods.name: T GetPixelInterpFixed1616(const int fp_x_whole,const int fp_y_whole) const
methods.description: Performs bilinear interpolation with fixed 16.16 precision pixel coordinates.

methods.name: bool ValidPixel(const int x,const int y) const
methods.description: Checks if a pixel coordinate is within valid bounds.

methods.name: BoundingBox GetContainingBox() const
methods.description: Returns the bounding box containing all pixels of the image.

methods.name: bool Contains(const BoundingBox & bounding_box) const
methods.description: Checks if the image contains a given bounding box.

methods.name: bool ValidInterpPixel(const float x,const float y) const
methods.description: Checks if a floating point coordinate is valid for interpolation.

methods.name: void DownsampleAveraged(const T * const original,const int stride,const int factor)
methods.description: Downsamples the image by averaging blocks of pixels.

methods.description: Downsamples the image by selecting the nearest pixel (nearest neighbor).

methods.description: Calculates the y-gradient at a pixel using Scharr operator.

methods.description: Computes the x-derivative of the image.

methods.name: void DerivativeY(const Image<U> & original)
methods.description: Computes the y-derivative of the image.
